LanguageData.HD_ChampionDesc: Challenge this delegation's representative. Both fighters need to be awake, healthy and undrafted. The arena must be clear. The opponent matches your allowed weapon, material, quality and condition.
LanguageData.HD_NotReady: Cannot begin. Equip an allowed weapon and check health, consciousness and pending duels.
LanguageData.HD_QuestDesc: A settlement of {0} has insulted your colony. Travel to the marked delegation within ten days and choose a champion. Bring an allowed weapon; the representative will match it. The challenger's duel rules apply. Victory: 100 silver on site and +10 goodwill. Defeat, interruption or expiry: -5 goodwill. Other caravan members must stay outside the arena.
LanguageData.HD_RequestDesc: Begin a representative duel with this non-hostile faction. Creates a world quest near this settlement for ten days. Send an armed caravan and select its champion on arrival. A lawful victory earns 100 silver and +10 goodwill; failure costs 5 goodwill.
LanguageData.HD_Unavailable: No suitable site is available, or this faction already has a delegation or cooldown.
LanguageData.HD_Won: Your champion won the delegation duel: +10 goodwill and 100 silver at the arena.
